describes: Way P for a whole house (paint.py): what the corner's p3 (blender/parts/finish/finish.json `painted`, its rules and values used as they are) needs to grow to every wall and opening. `wear` grades the corner's failed paint below the floor by the facts; the rest places what the corner had no fact for. Sizes in metres, values in L*.

wear.describes: The street front is p3, its share 1. Another wall's share is its wear against the front's, at most 1: wear is (years since the last coat + years neglected) / the upkeep cycle (packs/stavanger-1989/house/paints.json upkeep: the last coat is the cycle's last turn before the house was let go, counted from its building, or a lean-to's) times the wall's exposure (paints.json weather: 1 facing the wet winds, `least` on the lee). Below 1 the corner's strengths, peel heights and run lengths take the share, and each kind of mark runs only from its threshold in `from` (the narrow runs first, then the tongue, then the peel at the casing's foot and on the tops). A sill falling less than `level` a metre is level, and leaks at its end toward the weather.

boarding.describes: The boarded windows (ref 09, Pedersgata 81, 1989): pale weathered ply, mid-light against the wall, with big water stains hanging from the head, `stretch` times taller than wide, their tide edges sharp; battens raw sawn wood gone pale grey in the weather, near the wall's own value, so they cross the sheet as light bars. In finish.json painted.boarding's fields, with `colour` [C, h] for way Pc. Replaces the corner's kept variant (c) on every house.

neglect.describes: What a let-go house reads as from the street stop on, in broad shapes only, never fine marks (paint.py neglect_values): a soft grey tongue under each sill, `reach` long and widening by `spread` a metre down; the upper wall grey under the eave's drip, `reach` down; the foot grey from the splash, `reach` up from the drip board; each L* darker at its source, falling off by `power`, its far edge wobbling by `wobble` of its reach over `cell` metres. All at the wall's severity: its wear (paint.py wear) plus `amount` times a neglect event's amount / 1000, eased from `from` (none) to `full`.

roof.describes: A slope's age in broad shapes (paint.py roof_values), in place of the corner's tile-by-tile values on the slopes (the ridge keeps them): the eave course darkest, its reach `courses` courses up the slope; moss and lichen down the pans from the ridge, a lane `width` of a tile's cover wide down each pan, each pan's reach from the ridge a share of the slope in `reach`; the slope that faces away from the sun `shadeL` darker. At the roof's age: years since it was built or last retiled, full at `fullYears`. Replaced tiles only where a fact holds a repair.

splash.describes: The foot's wetting where no drip names it: a gable takes its verge's run-off (finish.json marks.splash.gable); the lean-to's low eave has no gutter and drips its whole length (`leanEave`).

materials.describes: Materials the corner has none of, in finish.json painted.materials' fields: the roof's course planes are its tiles (`roof` takes their values), but lit by their own baked rolls, unflattened (flatUp 0: the s04 A/B, the rolls read as columns down the slope at the street stop and the dashes go); the lean-to's cast plinth, its felt and the chimney's render are guessed values in grey, not yet judged.

colour.describes: Way Pc's hue and chroma [C, h] for the materials above, as finish.json painted.colour.mats; the walls' and trims' paint is the pack's (paints.json: a 'repainted' event's, else the era's default), its L* the clay's.
